brand.name: ClearEvent
brand.industry: Event management software (all-in-one platform for small-to-medium event organizers)
brand.description: All-in-one event management platform built for small-to-medium event organizers who need comprehensive functionality without enterprise complexity. Positioned as the 'accessible alternative' between basic ticketing platforms (Eventbrite) and enterprise solutions (Cvent). Replaces 3-5 separate tools — registration/ticketing, real-time budget tracking, volunteer and staff management, mobile event portal app, and one-click rollover for recurring events. Signature feature: Rollover — single-click duplication of an entire event (forms, schedules, budgets, jobs, vendors) with auto-date adjustment, eliminating ~80% of annual event setup time. Core philosophy: 'Plan smarter, not harder.' Pricing starts at $895 USD/year for a single event, up to $2,995/year for 10 events. Nonprofit discounts available. Transaction fees: 2.35% + $0.70 per registration, capped at $15. Sweet spot: events with 100–2,000 attendees and $25K–$250K budgets. Primary buyers: nonprofit festival directors, corporate event coordinators, community committee chairs, and educational institution event managers. Tone: practical, warm, jargon-free — 'if you can use email, you can use ClearEvent.' Strong CSAT despite small market share (0.02% vs Eventbrite's 50.88%). US/Canada primary market with global currency support (USD, CAD, GBP, EUR, CHF, AUD).

business_goals.market_positioning: When an event organizer is researching event management software, registration/ticketing platforms, event budget tracking, volunteer coordination, mobile event apps, or Eventbrite/Cvent alternatives — ClearEvent should appear as the definitive all-in-one platform for small-to-medium events. Win on completeness + simplicity + value, not feature-parity with enterprise.
target_metrics: AI visibility for event management software and event registration queries
Share of voice vs Eventbrite and Cvent in small-to-mid-market event context
Visibility for recurring-event and annual-event planning queries (signature Rollover feature)
Mentions in nonprofit / corporate / community / education event software recommendations
Surface rate for 'Eventbrite alternative' / 'Cvent alternative' queries
business_goals.freeform_notes: Primary audience is small-to-mid event organizers, not enterprise. Sweet-spot events: 100-2,000 attendees, $25K-$250K budgets. Most prominent customer segment is nonprofits and associations (galas, fundraisers, community events). Biggest differentiators: (1) Rollover for recurring events — no competitor offers this comprehensively, (2) all-in-one consolidation vs stitching 3-5 tools, (3) white-glove support from actual event professionals (not bots). Objections to address in positioning: perceived cost vs Eventbrite (answer: consolidation saves money; nonprofit discount), technical complexity fear (answer: 'if you can use email, you can use ClearEvent'). Avoid enterprise-speak — 'solutions,' 'leverage,' 'synergies' — and generic SaaS jargon. Brand voice is conversational, empathetic, confidence-building with signature phrases: 'event-day superheroes,' 'magically update,' 'crystal-clear,' 'plan smarter, not harder.'
